prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, ankle-cut demi statue portrait, five-material body: real face and neck, one crystal arm, one stone arm, a water-filled glass torso, one full glass leg (thigh, knee and calf) with its own coloured water and contents ending in a sealed tip at the ankle, and one full wooden leg ending in a carved tip at the ankle. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished tips at the narrowest point of each lower calf, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in ko-gyaru makeup — deeply sun-tanned bronze makeup over real skin, bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long bleached blonde hair with sun-streaked highlights, a bright cheeky grin. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a huge thick gold hoop hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest wider than her shoulders, a waistline that still pulls in sharply, then an enormous belly and colossal wide hips flaring out again, her left arm made of crystal, her right arm made of carved stone, her left thigh, knee and calf a sealed glass vessel ending at the ankle, her right thigh, knee and calf carved wood ending at the ankle.

Boundary (skin to material, at the collarbones): a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, nowhere lower, never reaching her chest — never jagged, never zigzag, a clean straight cut like a cross-section, exactly like a clean slice through a cast-glass sculpture. Real skin above this straight line, the material immediately below it. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow. The vessel portion is already full of water right up to this same straight collarbone line and no higher.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent crystal, solid golden-yellow citrine crystal, with faint feathery inclusions and colour zoning, deep honey-gold where thickest and pale lemon at every thin edge, one continuous carved mass, never hollow, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same crystal. Light passes straight through it; the backdrop is visibly bent inside it.

Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved from ONE solid block of genuine turquoise, a vivid sky-blue to blue-green stone laced with fine dark matrix veining running through it in irregular webs, polished to a smooth, cool sheen, completely opaque, completely opaque, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same stone. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (chest, belly, hips): a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass (unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections, sharp white highlights, tiny trapped bubbles) in the exact shape of her torso, filled completely to the brim with clear amethyst-violet water — a distinctly different colour from her left leg below — no hollow space anywhere. Small bright fish and slow-drifting green water plants move freely through the whole filled torso, rising up to the collarbone line itself, never crowding.

Left leg (hip to ankle, the whole thigh, knee and calf): a sculpted vessel of the same clear glass (unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections, sharp white highlights, tiny trapped bubbles), filled with clear rose-pink water — a distinctly different colour from the torso's water above — holding a scattered handful of pale water-lily petals drifting slowly, weaving the length of the whole leg. At the narrowest point of the lower calf, just above the ankle, it curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the vessel simply reaching its natural end there.

Right leg (hip to ankle, the whole thigh, knee and calf): carved from ONE solid block of golden teak, a warm honey-brown wood with fine straight grain lines running the length of the wood and a natural oily sheen, polished smooth, completely opaque, completely opaque, the grain running unbroken down the whole leg. At the narrowest point of the lower calf, just above the ankle, it curves inward and rounds off into its own smooth, satin-polished carved tip — the wood simply reaching its natural end there.

Where each material meets its neighbour (left shoulder, right shoulder, left hip, right hip), the two distinct materials sit flush against each other with a thin, clean seam, deliberate and precise, never jagged or torn — always the finish of a sculpture, each material keeping its own colour, clarity and surface completely separate from the one beside it.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep violet on one side and a soft rose pink on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so violet light glances off the left half and rose-pink light glances off the right half — passing straight through the crystal arm, the glass torso and the glass leg, while only reflecting off the stone arm and the wooden leg. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
